complexity_signals.signal_name: Complexity-fit model (knowledge + uncertainty + context overhead) / available context
complexity_signals.description: Formula from CLAUDE.md memory note: complexity = (knowledge + uncertainty + context overhead) / available context. Intended to guide whether an item is a good fit for autonomous agent execution.
complexity_signals.enforcement_evidence: planner-rt-ica/SKILL.md states: 'Task complexity is the ratio of project-specific knowledge required to context window available — not implementation difficulty.' This is a definitional statement, not an evaluated branch. No skill flowchart contains a conditional that reads this ratio and routes differently based on it. grep across all skills/ for 'complexity.fit|complexity_fit|knowledge.*uncertainty.*context|available.context' returned one match in human-touchpoint-model.md ('What the agent knows (bound constraints, available context)') — a descriptive phrase, not a gate. docs/complexity-fit-and-economics-of-agents.md exists but is a design doc, not a skill file. docs/complexity-fit-adoption-conditions.md was NOT FOUND.
complexity_signals.enforcement_source: skills/planner-rt-ica/SKILL.md:Complexity Model (definition only); plugins/development-harness/docs/complexity-fit-and-economics-of-agents.md (design doc, not skill logic)
complexity_signals.gap: No skill flowchart evaluates the ratio and changes dispatch path, autonomy_mode, or agent tier based on it. The model is defined in planner-rt-ica as a conceptual framing for planners to keep in mind, but it is not an observable conditional branch that routes or blocks.

complexity_signals.description: ARL (Autonomy Routing Logic) escalation triggers — unbound constraints, high-risk changes lacking domain precedent, thrashing detection (3 NEEDS_WORK loops), NOT_CERTIFIED loops — intended to pause execution for human review at defined SAM stage gates.
complexity_signals.enforcement_evidence: sam-definition.md documents escalation criteria with specific triggers: 'Gate 1 (after S1): Escalate if unbound constraints or domain knowledge gaps. Gate 2 (after S4): Escalate if high complexity or novel architecture. After 3 NEEDS_WORK loops on the same task, escalate to human. After 2 NOT_CERTIFIED loops in S7, escalate to human.' human-touchpoint-model.md defines an escalation decision flowchart with Bound/Unbound/Mixed constraint types and Low/High Risk tiers. arl-touchpoints.md is a redirect stub pointing to human-touchpoint-model.md. evaluate-sdlc-layers/SKILL.md validates that ARL files exist. HOWEVER: implement-feature/SKILL.md and complete-implementation/SKILL.md contain no conditional branch reading constraint type or risk tier to gate progression. Thrashing detection (3-loop limit) is documented in sam-definition.md but no skill file contains a loop-count check or a NEEDS_WORK iteration counter that triggers escalation.
complexity_signals.gap: The ARL escalation criteria are documented in sam-definition.md and human-touchpoint-model.md but are not wired as conditional branches in implement-feature or complete-implementation skill flowcharts. No skill file counts NEEDS_WORK iterations and routes to a human escalation step at iteration 3. The model is a reference specification that specialist agents are expected to follow by convention, not a gate enforced by skill flowchart logic.

'Pre-existing plans that omit the autonomy field return "full_auto" (the Pydantic default)'. Explicit fork at line 74: 'If autonomy_mode == "per_task"' → single Agent call + per-task gate. Wave-Completion Confirmation Gate skips when full_auto or per_task (line 291). Enforcement in implement-feature is complete. These routing decisions are enforced within the groom workflow. HOWEVER: implement-feature/SKILL.md contains no reference to issue type, defect, or find-cause (grep returned no output). complete-implementation/SKILL.md contains no issue-type routing. The type classification written during grooming is not read by implement-feature to change dispatch strategy, agent selection, or verification approach. Issue type routing changes what grooming does; it does not change what implement-feature or complete-implementation do.

complexity_signals.signal_name: Proportional quality gates (no plan → shorter quality gates)
complexity_signals.description: When complete-implementation is invoked on an issue with no linked SAM plan, it runs a proportional 5-task quality gate (pqg- prefix) instead of the full 7-phase SAM dispatch loop, omitting T0 (Multi-Perspective Review) and T6 (Context Refinement).
complexity_signals.enforcement_evidence: complete-implementation/SKILL.md: Input format detection flowchart at line 81: 'Plan → No → proceed to Proportional Quality Gates'. 'Proportional Quality Gates: Entered only when the issue has no linked plan. Skip this section when input is a file path or when the issue has a linked plan (auto-resolved to SAM path).' Step 3 builds a 5-task SAM plan with pqg- prefix: 'The proportional plan omits T0 (Multi-Perspective Review) and T6 (Context Refinement) to stay proportional, but retains the T4/T5 documentation pass.' The pqg- vs qg- prefix distinction is documented and enforced as a structural difference in the plan created.

complexity_signals.description: Wave 0 (pre-swarm technical research via technical-researcher agent) is optional in the groom workflow. The condition controlling whether it runs determines how much pre-research context is available before Wave 1 teammates are spawned.
complexity_signals.enforcement_evidence: groom/swarm.md Wave 0 section specifies explicit skip conditions as a bulleted list: 'Skip Wave 0 when: (1) Item type is type:bug or type:fix — fact-checker covers the primary research need; (2) Item has no identifiable technology, library, or internal module to research; (3) Item description is a pure administrative or labelling task with no research questions.' depth parameter is also conditional on type: 'overview for procedural/fix items, standard for features and refactors, deep for unbounded-design items'. The positive trigger (run Wave 0) is implicit — it runs for all items that do not match any skip condition. If technical-researcher returns STATUS: BLOCKED (all four angles returned only gaps), proceed to Wave 1 without halting.
